name: Acid
summary: Thrown vial: a creature or object within 20 ft makes a Dex save or takes 2d6 Acid damage.
text: When you take the Attack action, you can swap one of your attacks for throwing this vial at a creature or object you can see within 20 feet. The target makes a Dexterity saving throw against DC 8 + your Dexterity modifier + your Proficiency Bonus; on a failure it takes 2d6 Acid damage. The vial is used up.
